## Changes

### Features

- devtools: add nested data search (#12522) (f69b28a1d) by @TkDodo

### Fix

- vue-query: accept shared options in imperative queries (#12525) (e7124128c) by @TkDodo

### Performance

- query-devtools/tsdown.config: add '@refresh skip' banner so the app's 'solid-refresh' does not wrap the bundled Solid runtime (#12517) (1176d373d) by @sukvvon

- deps: align 'catalog', 'vue' and 'next' dev ranges with examples after the security update (#12515) (e877443ca) by @sukvvon
- integrations: add missing 'preact', 'sveltekit', 'nuxt', 'solid-start' and 'astro' integrations and align existing ones (#12507) (b38ddac2b) by @sukvvon
- deps: update security dependencies in examples and integrations (#12509) (b1243facc) by @TkDodo
- *: update Angular to v22 and TypeScript to v6 in Angular examples and integration (#12506) (df4738d4e) by @sukvvon
- examples: update dependencies that pull older 'esbuild' versions (#12505) (84f5b0f5b) by @sukvvon

Release 2026-11-02 13:56

## Changes

### Fix

- query-core: share fetch results across silent cancellations (#12489) (b6576b388) by @TkDodo
- query-core: stop cancelled streamed queries from updating the cache (#12481) (af0e0ef5f) by @TkDodo
- query-core: exclude status from mutation count filters (#12480) (8d0dc278a) by @TkDodo
- examples/{react,solid,vue}/contacts-*: wait for the seed before reading contacts and separate the unfiltered list key from a search for 'all' (#12482) (4223498dc) by @sukvvon
- query-core: unpause a mutation that can start after its onMutate (#11788) (05d9b6a40) by @maxymlyskov
- query-core: handle the rejection of paused refetches in 'refetchQueries' with 'throwOnError' (#12442) (e69cac69d) by @lazerg
- query-core: addToEnd caps result to max when items already exceeds max (#10969) (2ee2fd935) by @JSap0914
- query-core: use '() => void' instead of DOM-only 'VoidFunction' (#12447) (f2215d259) by @recallhyx
- query-core: shallowEqualObjects ignores key-set differences when counts match (#10777) (86e79571f) by @francisjohnjohnston-web
- {react,preact}-query: set the observer options before subscribing (#12230) (1e1caa5a3) by @lazerg

### Refactor

- examples: replace 'sort-by', 'localforage' and 'font-awesome' with built-in code (#12490) (59d11de87) by @sukvvon
- examples/angular/basic: make 'postId' a required input and remove the always-true 'enabled' in 'PostComponent' (#12170) (604d0a5aa) by @sukvvon
- examples/react/nextjs-app-optimistic-updates: type the form submit handlers with 'React.SubmitEvent' instead of the deprecated 'React.FormEvent' (#12095) (92c41c059) by @sukvvon

### Chore

- {examples,integrations}: fix configs that break with the installed tool versions (#12491) (d0ff9aef5) by @sukvvon
- integrations: group by adapter and rename packages to '@tanstack/query-integration-<adapter>-<name>' to match examples (#12475) (9b52414c1) by @sukvvon
